copy.tagline_60c: Free 2026 Romanian public & private pension calculator
copy.awesome_list_bullet: - [CalculatorPensie.com](https://calculatorpensie.com/) - Free Romanian pension calculator implementing Law 360/2023 (VPR 81 Lei), CASS tax, stability points, and Pillar II/III projections.
copy.description_160c: Calculate gross and net Romanian pensions for 2026 under Law 360/2023 (VPR 81 Lei), CASS 10% above 3,000 Lei, Annex 5 retirement age, and Excel CSV export.
copy.description_500c: CalculatorPensie.com is a free client-side pension simulation suite built for Romania under Law 360/2023, OUG 156/2024, Law 141/2025, and Law 44/2026 budget constants. Users can estimate gross and net monthly public pensions at the official VPR of 81 Lei, apply the 10% CASS and 10% income tax rules above 3,000 Lei, compute stability point bonuses beyond 25 contributory years, model early retirement penalties between 0.15% and 0.40% per month, project Pillar II (4.75%) and Pillar III (400 EUR/yr tax relief) funds, and export an Excel CSV workbook with zero signup or server storage.

taxonomy.free_tier_details: 100% free in browser with no account required
